name: wallet-card

frames.best_why: The full card is clear with no pointer over its details, and the stack edges and member row show below.

tagline: A purple bank card stacked over others, with balance and member avatars.
summary: A stack of payment cards fans back in 3D while the front card shows its holder, masked number, expiry and balance. A button hides the balance and an avatar row lists members.
appearance: A glossy purple gradient card with a gold chip, contactless glyph and VISA mark, showing a dollar balance, masked digits and holder details. Thin coloured edges of two cards peek from beneath, with overlapping avatars and a small Hide balance pill below.
behaviour: Moving the pointer across the card slides a soft white sheen toward it. Clicking a stacked edge or using arrow keys brings another card forward, and Hide balance blurs the digits.
demo_content: Everyday card for Maya Chen, balance $12,480.52, ending 4821; avatars for Maya, Leo, Ana, Sam, Ivy and Ola
search_phrases: virtual card list for a banking app
card with moving shine on hover
use_when: A banking or fintech screen wants to show several payment cards as a tactile stack with balances.
avoid_when: Light or themed surfaces, since the white type and grain are tuned for dark card gradients.
customise: Accounts and members arrive as typed arrays with gradient classes, holder, last4, network and avatars; active and hidden state can be controlled. Stack depth and springs are constants.
weight_why: Three card buttons, a few avatars and spring animations; the sheen only moves on hover.

a11y.note: A labelled listbox supports arrow-key switching, balances carry aria-labels and motion is reduced on request.

issues: The cards behind the front one are almost hidden, so the stack reads as a single card at this angle.
polish_why: Convincing card surface with grain and chip detail; the hidden stack edges are easy to miss.
title: Wallet Card
